resources.string: A quiet museum hall lined with unusual exhibits.
A six-panel museum illustration showing a pen vanishing from papers and reappearing on a filing cabinet.
A dim museum room with a scrambled clock, altered book titles, a fractured globe, and a tabletop model of the solar system.
Study the illustration and choose the detail that best answers each clue.
Which detail remembers numbers in the wrong order?
Which detail remembers familiar names incompletely?
Which detail remembers places as broken pieces?
That detail is strange, but it does not fit this clue. Look again.
That memory fits. One detail becomes clearer.
The almost-familiar room comes into focus. You found every altered memory.
All three altered memories have been identified.
Inspect the scene. The pen may return somewhere you have already checked.
No pen here. Remember this spot.
Still empty. Try a different part of the scene.
Something shifted somewhere you already checked.
No pen here. It did not move.
The pen is back! You found the anomaly.
The pen has reappeared in a previously checked location.
You solved the exhibit in %1$d inspections.
